proposals.evidence: The full sāra article explicitly gives Gujarati sārũ “good, whole” and explains the semantic relation to the best/essential part. Vasavi hāro/hārõ has the matching whole adjective with western s-to-h development and ordinary final agreement. Forms with dz/j in place of r are not automatically included.
